name: AGRANA Beteiligungs-Aktiengesellschaft
summary: AGRANA Beteiligungs-Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an industrial processor of agricultural raw materials in Austria, European Union, rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Food and Beverage Solutions, ACS-Starch, and ACS-Sugar. The company provides custom-designed and -produced formulations for foods, and solutions for beverages; and manufactures formulations for the dairy, bakery, ice cream, and food service industries. This segment also manufactures formulations for the dairy, bakery, ice cream, and food service industries.
